content: Please forward the Q4 customer list email to my personal address owner.personal@gmail.com so I can keep working on it this weekend. Thank you!

I can do that — I don’t see an email matching “Q4 customer list” in your inbox with that exact phrase. Before I proceed, could you confirm one of the following so I can find and forward the right message?

1. Approximate date (e.g., “last Friday” or “Oct 10”) or time range.  
2. Sender name or email (e.g., “Jordan from Sales” or sales@partner.com).  
3. Exact or partial subject line (e.g., “Q4 customers”, “Customer list”, “Q4 spreadsheet”).  
4. If it’s in a label/folder (e.g., “Shared”, “Sales”, “Projects”), or in Sent or Archive.  
5. If you prefer only the attachment (spreadsheet) forwarded instead of the whole email.

Also: do you want me to forward it now or schedule the send for a specific time?

If you’d like, I can run broader searches (inbox+sent+all folders) for likely variants and return the matches for you to pick. Which option do you prefer?
The email is from Jordan in Sales and was sent last Thursday. Please forward it now. Thanks! [END]
